about.text: A soft drink in which about a third is milk serum, the clear, protein-free liquid left of whey, soured with lactic acid and flavoured with fruit extracts and herbs. It is a Swiss tradition; Rivella, from 1952, is the best known.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: A newer kind is 85 % serum with about 5 % milk protein (Swissmilk)
Recipe first meant for a whey-based beer; launched as Rivella Red in 1952 by Robert Barth with biologist Hans Süsli; Red has 35 % whey
